artifacts.summary: Five sequential phases (6h) to write, register, and deploy the ztime-no-finite-carrier-fmp.md context note in the formal extension source store, covering both the finite-carrier refutation (Probe706, theta) and the finite-width refutation (Probe710, Phi) with the strengthened design rule, the published counterpart (GKWZ/HWZ quasimodels), the FMP-failure-is-not-undecidability warning, and fidelity labels.

memory_candidates.content: A logic-domain context note for this repository is a three-file deliverable in the formal extension SOURCE STORE (source_dir from .claude-extensions.json, currently /home/benjamin/.config/nvim/agent-system/extensions/formal): the note under context/project/logic/domain/, one entry appended to index-entries.json shaped like the frame-constraint-landscape.md entry (path, summary, category domain, line_count, load_when.agents [logic-research-agent, formal-research-agent], load_when.task_types [logic, formal], domain project, subdomain logic, topics), and one line under the logic README's Domain Files. Then deploy-headless.sh regenerates .claude/. The source store is its own git repo and is often dirty with sibling extensions' edits, so stage the three paths explicitly. The task-reference lint passes specs/NNN_... PATHS but fails 'task N' phrasing, so cite probes and reports by path.
